jobs.job_description:
Are you passionate about building high-quality software that users love? Gathern is looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to support the delivery of reliable, high-performing products. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to validate features, report issues, and ensure our apps and services meet the highest quality standards.
You’ll contribute to our QA activities across manual and automated testing, participate in Agile ceremonies, and help improve how we test and deliver features. If you're detail-oriented, curious, and eager to grow in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to test features and report issues clearly and efficiently.
Execute manual test cases and support the development of automated tests across mobile and backend platforms.
Validate features during sprints and contribute to regression and exploratory testing cycles.
Document bugs and test results in Jira with clarity and context.
Participate in sprint planning and backlog grooming to provide a QA perspective.
Support QA team initiatives to improve test coverage and reduce bug leakage.
Use tools like Firebase, Datadog, and Postman to validate backend behavior, error rates, and app stability.
Follow and contribute to QA processes across the product lifecycle.
1 - 3 years of experience in software quality assurance or a similar role.
Familiarity with Agile software development and testing practices.
Experience testing mobile applications (iOS and Android) and backend APIs.
Ability to write clear and concise bug reports and test documentation.
Basic understanding of test automation tools and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and a team-first mindset.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Fluency in Arabic and good command of English.
Nice-to-Have Skills:
Exposure to automation frameworks (e.g., Appium, Postman, Cypress).
AI-Assisted Testing: Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to support test case generation, exploratory testing, test data creation, and bug analysis.
Interest in AI-driven QA, automation, and emerging tools that improve testing efficiency and software quality.
Knowledge of QA metrics and reporting tools.
Familiarity with tools like Jira, GitHub, TestRail, or similar.
Why Join Gathern?
Be part of a collaborative and innovative team driving quality excellence.
Work on cutting-edge products with real-world impact.
Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.

Lenovo has expanded from its position as a leading PC company to offer a comprehensive portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices, infrastructure, software, solutions, and services. The Role: Sr. Manufacturing Quality Engineer Lenovo is seeking a Sr. Manufacturing Quality Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is open to Saudi Nationals and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The position focuses on leading quality management throughout the product lifecycle, from new product introduction to mass production, ensuring high standards and continuous improvement in manufacturing operations. Key Responsibilities • Lead quality management during the server New Product Introduction (NPI) phase by identifying quality risks and potential issues, and driving cross-functional teams to implement corrective and preventive actions. • Manage manufacturing quality during the mass production phase by proactively identifying quality problems, conducting root cause analysis, and driving effective resolution to ensure continuous quality improvement. • Oversee on-site quality management at the KSA factory. • Ensure quality processes, inspection standards, and manufacturing controls are effectively implemented and maintained across production operations. • Monitor manufacturing quality performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational excellence. • Collaborate closely with Development, Manufacturing Engineering, MPM, SQE, Test Engineering, and Site Operations teams. • Ensure all factors that may impact product quality are effectively identified, controlled, and continuously monitored. • Drive cross-functional collaboration to resolve quality issues and prevent recurrence through systematic corrective actions. Candidate Requirements • 5-10 years of experience in manufacturing quality engineering or a related field. • Demonstrated ability to lead quality initiatives and drive continuous improvement. • Strong analytical skills for root cause analysis and problem resolution. • Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional teams. • This position is open to Saudi Nationals. Employee Benefits and Development Lenovo offers a supportive work environment with various benefits and opportunities for professional growth. Employees have access to an international team with a focus on gender diversity and an Employee Assistance Program for psychological, legal, and financial consultancy. The company prioritizes sustainable solutions, including CO2 Offset, Asset Recovery Services, and the Lenovo Certified Refurbished portfolio. Additionally, employees can benefit from an internal e-learning development platform and a mentorship program for personal development.

## About the Role
BEC Arabia is seeking a highly skilled **QA/QC - Civil Engineer** to join our dynamic team in Riyadh. This role is integral to ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance across our civil engineering projects, which include government mega-projects, commercial developments, and infrastructure initiatives aligned with Saudi Vision 2030. As part of the QA & QC Department, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to implement and monitor quality assurance and control processes that meet both client and regulatory expectations.

In this role, you will oversee quality inspections, ensure adherence to project specifications, and maintain compliance with the **Saudi Building Code (SBC)** and other relevant standards. You will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging cutting-edge tools and methodologies to enhance project outcomes. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on some of the Kingdom's most prestigious projects, including NEOM and Red Sea developments, while advancing your career in a supportive and innovative environment.

Your day-to-day activities will include conducting site inspections, preparing quality documentation, coordinating with contractors and consultants, and ensuring compliance with **ISO 9001** standards. This is a career-defining opportunity to make a tangible impact on the quality and sustainability of Saudi Arabia's infrastructure landscape.

## Key Responsibilities
- **Develop** and implement project-specific QA/QC plans in alignment with client requirements and regulatory standards.
- **Conduct** regular site inspections to ensure compliance with project specifications, drawings, and applicable codes.
- **Monitor** construction activities to identify and address quality issues proactively.
- **Ensure** adherence to the **Saudi Building Code (SBC)** and other relevant standards.
- **Prepare** and maintain quality documentation, including inspection reports, test plans, and non-conformance reports.
- **Coordinate** with contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders to resolve quality-related issues.
- **Review** and approve material submittals, method statements, and shop drawings for compliance.
- **Implement** and monitor **ISO 9001** quality management systems across assigned projects.
- **Conduct** root cause analysis and recommend corrective actions for non-conformances.
- **Train** project teams on quality standards, procedures, and best practices.
- **Support** internal and external audits, ensuring timely closure of audit findings.
- **Promote** a culture of quality and continuous improvement across all project phases.

## Required Qualifications
- **Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering** or a related field.
- Minimum of **5 years of experience** in QA/QC roles within the construction or civil engineering industry.
- Registration with the **Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE)**.
- In-depth knowledge of **Saudi Building Code (SBC)** and **ISO 9001** standards.
- Proficiency in quality management tools and software, such as **Primavera P6**, **AutoCAD Civil 3D**, and **MS Office Suite**.
- Strong understanding of construction materials, methods, and testing procedures.
- Familiarity with **NEBOSH** or equivalent safety certifications.
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

## Preferred Qualifications
- **Master’s degree** in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
- Certification as a **Certified Quality Engineer (CQE)** or equivalent.
- Experience working on **Saudi Vision 2030** giga-projects.
- Knowledge of **LEED**, **Mostadam**, or other green building standards.
- Proficiency in advanced quality management tools such as **SAP Quality Management Module**.

## Working Conditions
- Based in **Riyadh**, with frequent site visits to construction locations.
- Work environment includes both office settings and active construction sites.
- Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) required during site visits.
- Exposure to varying weather conditions typical of the Riyadh region.
- Standard working hours with occasional extended hours to meet project deadlines.
- Limited regional travel may be required for project coordination.

## What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package, including health insurance and annual leave.
- Opportunities for professional development and certification sponsorship.
- A safety-first culture with a commitment to employee well-being.
- Exposure to iconic projects that shape Saudi Arabia’s infrastructure landscape.
- A multicultural and collaborative work environment.
- Career advancement opportunities within a leading construction and engineering firm.
- Access to state-of-the-art tools, technologies, and methodologies.

Project Overview:

The Ar Rjum Project comprises a green field gold project with three open pit mining operations with associated waste dumps and ore stockpile, a processing plant, tailings management facilities, and supporting infrastructure including water supply, power supply, maintenance facilities, offices, temporary and permanent accommodation village.
The Project is situated within the Central Arabian Gold Region, approximately 200 km north-east of Taif towards Riyadh and about 26 km South of Al Mouwayh, which is a small town situated on the Jeddah - Riyadh highway.

Job Summary:

Quality Assurance reports to the Project Quality Manager and verifies implementation of the quality program across one or more functions in engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning. This role ensures compliance with project and ISO 9001 requirements, supports the development of quality management system tools and metrics for monitoring quality performance, coordinates audits and inspections, manages corrective actions, and provides guidance to project teams on quality matters and improvement.

Major Responsibilities:

• Assist the Quality Manager in implementing and communicating the project quality program/plan requirements to the project team.
• Lead and support the implementation of People-Based Quality (PBQ), Lessons Learned, Closed Loop Corrective Actions, Continuous Improvement initiatives, and Best Practices, including the collection, evaluation, and documentation of lessons learned in the appropriate registers.
• Prepare quality audit checklists and coordinate, lead, or support internal and external audits and surveillances of project quality programs, including vendor, contractor, and subcontractor assessments.
• Maintain liaison with client quality representatives and support the Quality Manager during client or regulatory audits.
• Support the development, maintenance, and execution of the Project Quality Audit & Surveillance Schedule, ensuring timely follow-up and closure of audit findings and corrective actions.
• Monitor quality activities across engineering, procurement, and construction to ensure compliance with approved quality plans, procedures, and specifications, and review related documents for inclusion of quality requirements.
• Review and determine applicable quality and regulatory requirements, report new or revised regulations, and support the development and revision of QA procedures and project-specific quality documentation.
• Coordinate and perform inspections and surveillances at site and vendor locations, maintain accurate inspection records, and issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) as required.
• Assist in root cause analysis and closed-loop corrective action processes to ensure timely resolution and closure of findings.
• Participate in the prequalification of subcontractors and suppliers by evaluating their quality systems, capabilities, and controls, and reviewing their submittals such as quality manuals, procedures, quality plans, ITPs, resumes for quality personnel, test reports, audit reports, and schedules.
• Provide training and guidance to project personnel on quality requirements and procedures and conduct project QMS orientation and awareness sessions as applicable.
• Report quality weekly/monthly progress to the project quality manager

Education and Experience Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (preferably in Electrical Engineering).
• ISO 9001:2015 Certified Lead Auditor (IRCA approved) – required.
• Additional certifications in Quality (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean) – preferred.
• Minimum 10–12 years of relevant experience, including minimum 8 years in a supervisory role in quality.
• Experience in QA/QC activities across engineering, procurement, and construction phases.
• Previous experience with National Grid (NG) and Saudi Electricity Co (SEC) specifications and projects.

Required Knowledge and Skills:

• Strong understanding of quality assurance principles and ISO standards.
• Ability to interpret technical specifications, drawings, and quality plans.
• Strong analytical skills with practical knowledge of how to identify key performance quality matrices, proficiency in root cause analysis and corrective action systems.
• Proficiency in providing direction and on the job training to assigned personnel.
• Proficiency in oral and written communications.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management and presentation skills.
• Proven skills in Microsoft Office, Power BI (High Level Performance).
• Ability to work collaboratively under the direction of the Quality Manager and lead quality activities effectively.
• Experience with developing training materials, conducting training especially in soft skills, quality audits/ surveillances.
